snippet.title: Eternally - Launch Trailer | Out Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Eternally is out now on Steam, 15% off for launch week.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4281030/Eternally/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch

A dark fantasy tactical RPG where every attack is a dice roll on a hex grid. Build one of four Eternals from 260+ skills across 17 skill trees, then take them through an eight-chapter campaign.

Play alone, online with up to 3 friends, or with 1 friend on the same PC. PvP too.

Made by one developer at Astral Kranium.
Discord: https://discord.gg/8VygeFwm2Q
